title: Adding a service marks the origin without replacing an earlier one
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Maintenance Reminders QA build as an Owner/Admin (any user who can open Settings > Maintenance and create and edit work orders and customers).
  2. Open Settings > Maintenance. Open the schedule 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM', or create it with New schedule: add service 'PM-A' with a Calendar trigger of Every 6 months and canned lines, for example 'Engine oil and filter change' 0.8 hours, 'Chassis lubrication, 12 points' 0.5 hours, 'Air filter inspection' 0.3 hours and 'Brake adjustment check' 1.2 hours (4 lines, 2.8 hours). Save. Also add service 'PM-B' with a Calendar trigger of Every 12 months and canned lines.
  3. Enroll units 'ZZAUTOTEST 402' and 'ZZAUTOTEST 403' so PM-A and PM-B read Overdue on both.
  4. Create work order W1 for 402 by hand (New Work Order) with no service on it.
  5. Open Customers > Maintenance reminders (the worklist). On 403's PM-A row press Create work order; note the new work order W2.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders and read the Maintenance schedule column for W1 (empty) and W2.
  2. On W1 expand the Maintenance schedule card and press Add Service > Add on PM-B. Read W1's Maintenance schedule cell.
  3. On W2 expand the card and press Add Service > Add on PM-B. Read W2's cell.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Before step 2, W1 has no origin and its Maintenance schedule cell is empty.
  • After Add Service, W1 shows 'ZZAUTOTEST Highway Tractor PM' and (in the design) a line saying the work order was created earlier and the service was added with Add Service, for example Created earlier · PM-B added with Add Service.
  • W2 keeps the origin it already had from the worklist; adding PM-B does not replace it.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10577 (S22, Origin reporting); Chunk 2 MR (Confluence 897679389) as edited 5 October 2026, S22; Design MR_V2_2 (Claude Design export, 6 Oct 2026), driven in full on 6 Oct 2026, Chunk 2 board artboard W14; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S22-E1: “A service added to an existing work order marks that work order's origin without replacing an origin it already had”
  • S22-R1: “A work order carries the origin when it was created from a due service, or when Add Service added a service to it”
  • Design, Chunk 2 board, artboard W14, cell for a work order created earlier: “Created earlier · PM-B added with Add Service”
